## 2. Engineering Philosophy
- **Component-Driven Architecture**: Clean separation of state, presentational elements, and business logic.
- **Performance & Accessibility**: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance, semantic HTML5, zero-layout-shift (CLS) optimization, Lighthouse target 95+.
- **Real-World Utility**: Building applications that solve concrete daily problems (canteen queue elimination, repair logistics, educational administration).
- **Responsive Across All Viewports**: Fluid clamp typography and layout grids ensuring optimal readability on mobile screens (360px) up to ultra-wide displays.

## 3. Detailed Case Studies & Architectures

### 3.1 RyphTech: Technology Brand & Web Platform
- Canonical URL: https://thanzeer-j.is-a.dev/work/ryphtech
- Live Website: https://ryphtech.in/
- Year: 2026
- Role: Full-Stack Web Developer
- Technology Stack: React.js, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Cloudflare R2
- The Challenge:
  Establishing an authoritative brand presence for RyphTech that articulates complex digital capabilities, service offerings, and enterprise software competence with high visual impact and fast load times.
- The Engineering Solution:
  Implemented a modular component hierarchy in React, utilizing Tailwind CSS for design consistency. Leveraged Vite bundling and image optimization via Cloudflare R2 object storage to ensure Lighthouse scores in excess of 98.
- Metrics & Results:
  - Deployment Status: Live in production
  - Responsive Layout: 100% multi-device test pass
  - Performance: Lighthouse score 98+

### 3.2 MealHub: Digital Canteen Prebooking Platform
- Canonical URL: https://thanzeer-j.is-a.dev/work/mealhub
- Year: 2026
- Role: Full-Stack Application Developer
- Technology Stack: React Native, React.js, Firebase Cloud Firestore, Supabase, Tailwind CSS
- The Challenge:
  Educational institution canteens experience massive congestion during short lunch and recess intervals, resulting in 20-30 minute queues and unpredictable meal availability for students and staff.
- The Engineering Solution:
  Architected dual cross-platform applications (React Native for mobile and React.js for web) powered by real-time Firestore synchronization. Features include dynamic menu catalogs, live item stock indicators, cart ordering with timestamped slots, and an admin counter ledger.
- Metrics & Results:
  - Queue Congestion Reduction: Estimated 70% reduction
  - Real-Time Synchronization: Sub-second state updates via Firestore snapshot listeners
  - Ecosystem: Shared logic across mobile and web platforms

### 3.3 Repairro: Doorstep Repair & Service Logistics
- Canonical URL: https://thanzeer-j.is-a.dev/work/repairro
- Year: 2026
- Role: Mobile & Product Developer
- Technology Stack: React Native, Node.js, Cloud Firestore, Express.js REST APIs
- The Challenge:
  Transporting heavy electronics and home appliances (e.g. televisions, microwave ovens) to repair centers presents severe logistical hurdles. The system required a multi-stakeholder protocol coordinating customers, repair technicians, and pickup partners.
- The Engineering Solution:
  Constructed a 6-stage lifecycle tracking engine: (1) Doorstep pickup request, (2) Logistics dispatch, (3) Technician inspection & itemized quotation, (4) Customer transparent approval gateway, (5) Servicing, and (6) Return delivery with digital handover verification.
- Metrics & Results:
  - Lifecycle Stages: 6 coordinated status transitions
  - User Types: 4 distinct roles (Customer, Shop/Technician, Delivery Partner, Platform Admin)

### 3.4 Student Management Portal: Unified Campus System
- Canonical URL: https://thanzeer-j.is-a.dev/work/student-portal
- Year: 2025
- Role: Full-Stack Web Developer
- Technology Stack: React.js, Node.js, MongoDB, Express.js, REST APIs
- The Challenge:
  Fragmented student records, paper attendance sheets, and manual spreadsheet qualification calculations caused administrative delays and data inconsistencies during semester reviews and campus placement drives.
- The Engineering Solution:
  Engineered a centralized portal with Role-Based Access Control (RBAC). Implemented modules for attendance registers, internal marks assessment, student profiles, study material distribution, and an automated CGPA placement drive eligibility filter.
- Metrics & Results:
  - Core Modules: 10 integrated academic systems
  - Roles: 4 authenticated personas (Student, Faculty, Placement Officer, Head of Department)
  - Data Integrity: 100% verified relational schema
